title: Software Diagnostics & Performance Test Engineer
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
  
  
*SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.*
**What You Will Do**

* Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems.
* Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data.
* Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues.
* Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.
* Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes.
* Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas.
* Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses.
* Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations.
* Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes.
* Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks.
* Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas.
* Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior.
* Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions.
* Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.
* Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.
* Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions.
* Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation.
* Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis.

**Must-have Qualifications**

* Technical
* 5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company.
* Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as Java, C++, C#, Python, etc.
* Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems.
* Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
* Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components.
* Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products.
* Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.
* Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes.
* Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence.
* Behavioral
* Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.
* Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Willingness to challenge assumptions.
* Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
* Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them.
* Strong ownership of difficult investigations

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Job Role: Senior QA Engineer
  
  
Company: Appmaker by StarApps
  
  
Location: Kochi, Kerala (On-Site)
  
  
Experience: 3–5 Years
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
**About Appmaker By StarApps**
At StarApps, we build tools like Appmaker that help thousands of global e-commerce merchants turn their web stores into native mobile apps.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for an experienced QA Engineer to take overall ownership of our QA cycle. You'll do hands-on testing, build strong quality control so fewer issues reach QA in the first place, and
  
  
guide our current QA team. Your goal: catch issues early, reduce the number of QA cycles per release, and ship high-quality apps faster.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* QA Ownership: Own the end-to-end QA cycle, from requirement review to final releasesign-off.
* Quality Control: Set up quality checks, entry/exit criteria and checklists that stop issues early and reduce repeat QA cycles.
* Team Guidance: Mentor and guide the current QA team, review their test cases and bug reports, and raise the team's testing standards.
* Test Planning: Create test plans and test cases from the requirements and designs shared, covering functional, regression and edge cases.
* Device & Design Parity Testing: Test on real Android and iOS devices, and run design parity checks against approved designs.
* Bug Management: Report, prioritise and track bugs, document regressed bugs, and verify fixes with the dev team.
* Process Improvement: Find the root causes of recurring bugs and improve QA processes, tools and documentation.
* Communication: Keep management updated on release quality, risks and issues found.
* AI-Assisted Testing: Use AI tools to generate test cases and speed up testing, while reviewing the output carefully.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience: 3–5 years in software QA, with strong experience testing mobile apps.
* Ownership: Proven experience owning QA for releases and reducing QA cycles or bug
* leakage.
* Leadership: Experience guiding or mentoring junior QA engineers.
* Testing Expertise: Strong knowledge of test planning, functional, regression,
* smoke/sanity testing and the bug life cycle.
* QA Tools: Hands-on experience with QA tools like BrowserStack, Appium and bug

Requirements ownership (approx. 80%)

Delivery coordination (approx. 20%)

* Tooling. Proficiency with Jira; familiarity with Smartsheet and SharePoint.
* Communication. Excellent written and verbal English, at the standard required to write for and present to senior commercial stakeholders in the US and Europe, and to disagree constructively.

description:
This job is provided by apna.co Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Raw Material Inspection


  Assess species, size, grade, freshness, and physical condition.
   

  

  Verify receiving temperature and condition of chilled/frozen materials.
   

  

  Ensure supplier/lot identification and traceability. Reject or hold materials that fail to meet specifications.
   

  

* Processing Monitoring


  Oversee washing, grading, deheading/peeling, freezing, and glazing. Verify product temperature at
   

  

 critical stages.
   

  

  Ensure compliance with SOPs and product specifications.
   

  

* HACCP \& Food Safety


  Monitor CCPs/OPRPs and critical limits.
   

  

  Record monitoring results and act immediately on deviations.
   

  

  Verify corrective actions and follow\-up measures.
   

  

* Personal Hygiene \& GMP


  Monitor worker hygiene and protective clothing.
   

  

  Ensure proper handwashing/sanitization practices.
   

  

  Enforce GMP and GHP standards in processing areas.
   

  

* Hazard Control


  Monitor cleaning and sanitation chemicals.
   

  

  Prevent chemical and foreign\-body contamination.
   

  

  Inspect equipment, utensils, and processing areas for hygiene.
   

  

* Finished Product Inspection


  Check appearance, colour, odour, texture, size/grade, weight, glazing, packaging, and labelling.
   

  

  Verify product against customer and internal specifications.
   

  

* Packaging \& Labelling


  Confirm correct packaging materials are used.
   

  

  Verify product details: name, species, grade, net weight, production/expiry dates, lot/batch number,
   

  

 storage instructions. Ensure compliance with customer\-specific requirements.
   

  

* Cold Chain Monitoring


  Monitor freezing, cold\-room, and dispatch temperatures.
   

  

  Ensure frozen products are maintained at ≤ −18°C.
   

  

  Record and report deviations.
   

  

* Traceability


  Maintain traceability from raw material to dispatch.
   

  

  Verify GRN, production, packing, and dispatch records.
   

  

* Non\-Conformance \& Corrective Action


  Identify and segregate non\-conforming products/processes.
   

  

  Raise NCRs and investigate root causes. Verify corrective/preventive actions.
   

  

* Documentation


  Maintain QC inspection records, CCP monitoring logs, temperature checks, sanitation reports, product
   

  

 inspection reports, calibration records, etc. Ensure records are complete, accurate, and audit\-ready.
   

  

* Field Aquaculture Supervision


  To travel to farm location in and around Alappuzha and collect and report aquaculture farm data
   

  

 weekly/monthly as per company requirements and report it to the respective teams.
   

  

  Provide technical support and ensure compliance with Best Aquaculture practise standards for Basa
   

  

 farming/ Shrimp farming/ other species. Supervise harvesting and dispatch operations.
   

  

  Maintain detailed records of farming activities and produce reports for each visit.
   

  

 Skills \& Attributes
   

  

  Basic computer and MS office skills.
   

  

  Analytical thinking and attention to detail.
   

  

  Strong communication skills, especially in explaining technical concepts to farmers.
   

  

  Adaptability to diverse field conditions and travel requirements.
   

  

  Ability to work independently and in teams.
   

  

  Relationship\-building and trust with aquaculture farmers and train them in aquaculture techniques
   

  

 during field visits.
